find: partHome( db, block, cal, element, null, String )
replace: partHome( db, block, cal, element, null )

why: a link calibrated as the item part's home is the item part
a bar's slot lacks its -N class, so bars find no part
a part drawn by a shared wrapper class (the content band's .sgs-container__inner) would find no part
an :nth-of-type home would answer any slot
